Subject: Re: Fwd: Increased timeouts and 504s on checkout during morning spike

Quick triage from infra: we see a pattern of KV cache churn on the serving tier for the Lumex model group (model-hr-lumex-v2). Cache hit rates dropped ~40% at 08:40 which coincides with their traffic spike. Autoscaling also triggered but a subset of pods came up in a degraded mode (OOM throttling on one node).

Immediate actions I recommend (can be done in parallel):
- Increase model pool burst capacity by 30% for Lumex routing (temp)
- Pin latest stable variant (model-hr-lumex-v2-stable) to avoid fallback to larger-ram variant triggering cache miss penalty
- Rehydrate KV prefix cache for top 10 call signatures (script ready)
- Roll affected node out of rotation (pending OOM investigation)

I'm attaching a short screenshot of the cluster metrics and a link to the node logs. Will start the rehydrate script now.

-david
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

1) Temporarily relax per-request tokenization timeout to allow slow clients to complete (30s -> 60s)

I'll coordinate with ops to push the burst capacity adjustment and the cache rehydrate. If those stabilize within 20m, we can avoid a full customer-facing rollback.

I'll stand up a short war-room Zoom and invite Jenna + Claire; Grace, can you coordinate exec readout cadence (I suggest 09:45 PDT quick sync, 10:30 PDT customer update)?
